name: Unique Electronics Inc.
old_description: Industry leader in creative harnessing design assistance solutions since 1980
about:
Unique Electronics Inc. was established in 1980 in Orlando, Florida. The company operates as an employee-owned business, a structure it says fosters a culture of commitment and experience.

The company designs and manufactures interconnects, cable assemblies, and wire harnesses for military and aerospace applications. Its capabilities include in-house tooling, CAD/CAM modeling, and machining for rapid prototyping, allowing it to move from design to production quickly. It also offers design assistance to help customers optimize their interconnect solutions.

Unique Electronics serves the defense and aerospace sectors, counting six of the world’s top defense contractors and the U.S. Government among its customers. Its NADCAP-accredited processes (AC7121) for electronics cable and harness assemblies meet the stringent requirements of those markets, and the company holds AS9100 Rev. D and ISO 9001:2015 certifications.

The company emphasizes creative harnessing design assistance as a core differentiator, backed by its quality certifications. Its employee-owned model is presented as a driver of accountability and long-term customer relationships, with a focus on commitment and experience.
